name: Cloutly
oneLiner: Review management platform for multi-location businesses that collects reviews by SMS, email and QR code, monitors review sites in one inbox and shows reviews on your website.
bestFor: Small multi-location service and hospitality businesses that want simple, per-location review campaigns and a shared review inbox.
features: Automated review request campaigns by SMS and email, with no login needed to leave a review
QR codes to collect reviews from walk-in customers
One inbox for Google, Facebook and 40+ other review sites (other sites on Growth and up)
Draft with AI (Magic Response) replies based on what each review says, posted back to the site
White-label option for agencies and resellers

pricing.text: Per location, month to month with a 14-day free trial: Starter $27/month (Google and Facebook only), Growth $63–69/month, Power $73–79/month depending on billing, and Custom for 15+ locations.

notes: Plan prices come from search snippets of cloutly.com/plans and partner listings (G2, Mindbody), which disagree slightly (monthly vs annual), so they are given as ranges; check before quoting. No dated 2025–2026 product news found. Customers are testimonials on cloutly.com (Swimart is a pool-supply chain, Swyftx a crypto exchange); no named restaurant customer found. Original price '$27 to $63/month' updated.
